purpose: Continue the offline three-session walk-forward program after terminal Campaign063 by selecting at most one economically distinct mechanism from frozen definitions and source schemas before any Campaign064 value is opened.

schema_only_source_boundary.fixed_grid: 09:31--11:30 and 13:01--15:00 exactly 240 high/low bars; exclude standalone 09:30 and never form a lunch-spanning triple

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures the diversity of local ordinal volatility-regime transitions using intrabar ranges only. No prior definition measures the 13-state weak-order distribution of consecutive high/low range triples.
Unordered range allocation entropy is already terminal. The selected concept discards range shares and clock labels after forming within-half local triples, retaining only weak order.

Pearson range persistence, adjacent overlap, and midrange-width change coupling are already terminal or near-terminal families. They use magnitude or paired linear dependence rather than a finite ordinal transition alphabet.
Spectral, strict permutation, transition-matrix, higher-lag, or Markov choices would open estimator and alphabet searches. One exact weak-order marginal entropy with ties retained is selected.
Zero intrabar ranges and repeated ranges are economically meaningful. The 13 weak-order states retain exact ties with zero tolerance and avoid arbitrary jitter or deletion.

Campaign035 already sequences signed close returns. The selected concept is invariant to every admissible close path when high/low ranges are fixed and changes when high/low ranges change with closes fixed.
Both complete halves, 118 triples per half, tuple length three, higher direction, no filter, and no combination are fixed once.

selected_concept.mechanism: Transform each fixed minute bar to nonnegative log high-low range, take every overlapping triple separately within each half, classify exact pairwise comparisons into the 13 transitive weak-order states, and measure the normalized entropy of the pooled state distribution.
selected_concept.economic_question: Does greater diversity in local volatility-regime ordering indicate distributed information processing rather than persistent clustered stress, with an effect that can persist from the next open through the third close?
known_design_risks: Weak-order entropy on range triples may correlate with unordered range participation entropy or range update frequency and must pass all frozen no-return comparisons before returns.
Exact ties can dominate on illiquid names; ties are retained by definition and coverage/uniqueness gates must fail closed rather than filter names after values.
Tuple length, tie semantics, pooling, entropy normalization, direction, time grid, and missing rules create researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values.
The current-listing-derived source and holding universes retain the documented survivorship limitation.

decision.required_next_step: Perform and bind one exact no-value mechanism-overlap audit. Only if it passes may Campaign064 freeze source fingerprints, all 95 ordered comparisons, coverage and novelty gates, one finite development trial, code, and synthetic tests before values.
